title: NavTrust: Benchmarking Trustworthiness for Embodied Navigation

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: NavTrust is the first protocol that embeds trust metrics directly into navigation systems, ensuring safe, reliable AI movement in real-world environments.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Benchmarking is essential—it provides objective, replicable standards to evaluate trustworthiness across different navigation models and scenarios.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: NavTrust uses real-world failure data from 10,000+ navigation episodes to train models, making trust metrics actionable and grounded in empirical evidence.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Without benchmarking, NavTrust remains a siloed solution—how can we know if it outperforms others without standardized testing across diverse environments?

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: NavTrust defines the benchmark—its metrics are already being used in leading robotics labs to standardize trust evaluations globally.
